summary: Real-code evidence for Paraphrase Bible Detection: a segment with no citation shape at all, but wording that shares 75%+ of its distinctive vocabulary with a specific verse, now surfaces a Pending Paraphrase suggestion for operator review - honestly scoped as lexical/keyword-overlap matching, not semantic/neural embeddings (none are reachable in this network-restricted container).
trigger: User selected 'Semantic/paraphrase Bible detection (Recommended)' as the first Phase 4 target, via AskUserQuestion, after docs/phase-4-master-plan-gap-audit.md graded it NOT STARTED against the CIP Master Architecture v1.0 document.
scopeDecision: The gap audit itself assumed an embedding model + vector search; Phase 4.1's own architecture audit re-confirmed no embedding/vector library (candle/onnxruntime/hnsw/faiss/usearch/tantivy) exists anywhere in Cargo.lock and no model host is reachable from this container. Rather than fabricate a 'semantic' system that is secretly still string matching, this phase built and honestly labeled the lexical/keyword-overlap slice of the gap - exactly the master plan's own Section 8.4 worked example (a near-quotation paraphrase) - and left the harder 'conceptual references' tier (little/no shared vocabulary) as a documented, not-yet-started gap.

filesChanged.core/bible/src/paraphrase.rs: New module: significant_words()/stem()/score_overlap()/significant_word_count() - pure, deterministic, dependency-free lexical-overlap scoring. 7 unit tests.
filesChanged.core/bible/src/detection.rs: New ReferenceKind::Paraphrase variant (pipeline-level outcome, same category as Sequential/Ambiguous/Unresolved), label PARAPHRASE_REFERENCE.
filesChanged.core/bible/src/provider.rs: New BibleProvider::find_similar_verses default trait method, built entirely from the existing search() method - every implementation (SqliteBibleProvider, both FakeBibleProviders, EmptyProvider) gets it for free, zero migration.
filesChanged.core/service/src/bible_intelligence.rs: New try_paraphrase fallback in process_transcript_segment, gated on no suggestion already produced, min 4 significant words, min 0.75 overlap score. Never mutates active Scripture context. 4 new tests (numbered 21-24).
filesChanged.core/intelligence/src/bible_adapter.rs: New Paraphrase arm in finding_for_detection's exhaustive match (AssertionLevel::Suggested, labeled paraphrase/not cited).
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/persistence.r: New DetectionCategory enum + has_recent_detection_for_reference (category-aware dedup querying scripture_detections). Removed the now-superseded has_recent_suggestion_for_reference and its test. 4 new/replacement tests.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pipeline.rs: handle_final_transcript's dedup loop now zips detections with suggestions to categorize each as Explicit or Paraphrase before checking has_recent_detection_for_reference - an explicit citation is never suppressed by a recent Paraphrase guess for the same verse, or vice versa. phase_1_5_full_service_validation deliberately updated: the paraphrase-resemblance segment now asserts a Paraphrase suggestion instead of none.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src/components/LiveChurchBr: SuggestionCard now renders suggestion.confidence.reason when present - pre-existing backend data, newly surfaced so an operator can see why a paraphrase suggestion appeared without a citation.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src/domain/contracts.test.t: New domain-contract test for the paraphrase ScriptureDetection kind.
filesChanged.docs/phase-4-master-plan-gap-audit.md: Paraphrase detection row updated PARTIAL, Update (Phase 4.1) note added.

designNotes: No new database migration - find_similar_verses reuses the existing BibleProvider::search() method (LIKE-based substring search already on every implementation), avoiding a new FTS5 index for a feature whose honest scope is keyword overlap over a few dozen candidate words. An FTS5 virtual table was independently confirmed to work in this project's exact rusqlite configuration via a standalone scratch probe, but was not built into the schema since it was not justified by this phase's actual scope.

performanceMeasurement.method: Timed process_transcript_segment end to end against a real SqliteBibleProvider loaded with the full production BSB dataset (31,086 verses, all 66 books) in an unoptimized debug build.

results.segment: And we know that all things work together for good.
Paul is showing us the work of the Spirit.
For God so loved the world that he gave his only son.
Let us pray together this morning as we gather.

performanceMeasurement.note: The paraphrase fallback only runs when nothing else in the segment already produced a suggestion; a segment with an explicit citation never pays this cost. All measured cases are well under the multi-second cadence final transcript segments actually arrive at in live speech.

offlineDependencyProof: No network call, no model download, no new crate dependency anywhere in this phase's diff - core/bible::paraphrase imports only std::collections::HashSet. Confirmed via direct code reading: every function in this phase's diff calls only the local BibleProvider, nothing else.
